key.name: todo-file-path
key.description: Absolute path of the markdown todo file used by the extension. An empty value means the default ~/todo.md.

key.name: category-colors
key.description: Maps a category name to a CSS color string (for example '#e01b24').

key.name: max-menu-height
key.description: Maximum height of the scrollable menu content area in pixels. The area scrolls when its content exceeds this height.
